Lead Weight. Cast discoid weight, for use with a balance. One side appears to have had a numerical legend stamped across it; this evidenced by a raised rectangular panel. The Roman numerals VI[--] seem to begin the legend, the rest of which is lost. The mass may suggest this to represent an underweight quarter of one uncia , roughly equivalent to the modern or averdepois ounce. Suggested date:…
